entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zbigniew Turski was a Polish composer. He was born in Konstancin and died in Warsaw. Polish composer and conductor Zbigniew Turski won the gold medal at the 1948 London Olympic Art Competitions for his Symfonia Olimpijska in the category of Music, Compositions for Orchestra.
